findings.issue: Common noun מָסָךְ (H4539, screen/covering, construct) is dumped as untranslated masaj instead of a Spanish noun.
Noun קוֹמָה (height) is smoothed to the adjective alto; the height measure is still present.

notes: Lemma 8336 b licenses lino fino despite the cardinal morph tag; singular אַמָּה and plural אַמּוֹת match codo/codos.
